scientific_question: Does the exact low-capacity DepMap target-feature PCA plus Ridge model learn a conserved raw genome-wide perturbation response that beats direct same-target source averaging under strict outer-context exclusion?

distinctness.experiment_097: Experiment 097 used donor response-matrix PCA coordinates as inputs and learned donor-to-donor response maps. Experiment 132 uses external DepMap target features and pools source contexts to learn a target-feature-to-response map.
distinctness.experiment_114: Experiment 114 used DepMap cosine neighbors for weak-row replacement and fit no response map. Experiment 132 is supervised global multi-output Ridge over every eligible target.

depmap_features.preprocessing_difference_from_upstream_r: Experiment 114 rows are finite-mean centered, missing-filled with zero, and L2 normalized. This experiment does not alter that authenticated artifact before upstream PCA plus Ridge.

source_contexts.k562_training_representation: arithmetic mean of K562-GWPS and K562-essential raw effects; omitted entirely for either K562 outer evaluation
source_contexts.pan_status: already-consumed training source only; never an independent outcome

target_contract.universe: exact-symbol intersection of all seven source target axes and authenticated DepMap rows, excluding all 300 VCC targets

response_axis.coverage: exact-symbol intersection of all seven source gene axes
response_axis.orion_duplicate_policy: last occurrence, matching the production donor mapping

candidate_grid.name: identity_source_mean
candidate_grid.definition: equal arithmetic mean of the five allowed biological source-context effects for the same target

candidate_grid.name: depmap_pca50_ridge10
candidate_grid.definition: authenticated DepMap target rows; upstream PCA-50; multi-output Ridge alpha 10 with intercept; five equal source contexts

selection.outer_evaluation: leave one biological context group out; score both K562 screens separately
selection.candidate_choice: identity wins unless Ridge clears every gate

untouched_source_test.stage: 410 frozen targets, opened only after a nonidentity selection freeze
untouched_source_test.refit: fit the same selected fixed model using only source responses for the untouched targets, with the same outer exclusions

metrics.pds: raw uncentered cosine retrieval, complete gallery, exact midranks, zero prediction equals 0.5
metrics.signed_credit: per target sum(sign(truth) times prediction) divided by sum(abs(prediction)); zero prediction equals zero

nulls.operation: derange the complete DepMap target-feature rows relative to target response labels within the selection or untouched-test split; keep the same random feature label across all source contexts and the held query

uncertainty.block_definition: connected components of reciprocal five-nearest-neighbor DepMap target-feature edges with cosine at least 0.40 on the untouched-test targets; this metadata-only threshold yields 353 blocks, 82 targets in multi-target blocks, and maximum block size 14
uncertainty.resampling: sample complete target blocks with replacement and use common multiplicities for every scored context
